basic_info.name: PuppyGraph
basic_info.description: A graph query engine for all your data.No ETLPuppyGraph enables you to query your data as a graph by directly connecting to your data warehouses and lakes. This eliminates the need to build and maintain time-consuming ETL pipelines needed with a traditional graph database setup. No more waiting for data and failed ETL processes.Deploy To Query In 10 MinsPuppyGraph's revolutionary query engine eliminates onboarding hassles that comes with a graph database, letting you deploy and start querying within just 10 minutes. Replacing an existing database? Effortlessly drop in PuppyGraph as the replacement, seamlessly connecting to third-party tools without the need for data or code migration.Petabyte-Level ScalabilityPuppyGraph eradicates graph scalability issues by separating computation and storage. Our auto-sharded, distributed computation effortlessly manages vast datasets. Querying directly from your warehouses, lakes, or multiple data sources, PuppyGraph empowers you to graph-query all your data, instead of only the data loaded into a graph database.10-Hop Queries In SecondsPuppyGraph delivers lightning-fast results, handling complex multi-hop queries like 10-hop neighbors in seconds. Our patent-pending technology efficiently leverages all computing resources, ensuring exceptional performance. Want to take it to the next level? More machines, more performance.

current.employee_description: PuppyGraph is a pioneering graph analytics engine that lets enterprises query their existing relational data stores — data warehouses, lakehouses, and databases — as a unified knowledge graph without any ETL or data duplication. What makes PuppyGraph uniquely powerful is how it bridges three transformative technologies: ontologies define the semantic meaning of entities and their relationships, turning raw data into machine-interpretable knowledge; knowledge graphs surface the hidden connections across petabytes of data, enabling complex multi-hop traversals in sub-second time; and AI agents — particularly Graph RAG — leverage that structured, semantically rich graph context to reason far more accurately than traditional text-to-SQL approaches, which notoriously fail at scale. Trusted by companies like Coinbase, Palo Alto Networks, eBay, and AMD, PuppyGraph deploys in under 10 minutes and supports both Gremlin and Cypher query languages, making it the connective tissue that turns siloed enterprise data into an intelligent, relationship-aware foundation for modern AI applications.

past.employee_description:
Neo4j is the world’s leading Graph Database that powers highly innovative and mission critical applications at hundreds of organizations worldwide. 

Graph databases are now the fastest-growing category in the database space, as companies discover the competitive opportunity that exists in utilizing the connections in their data. Key use-cases include Analytics, Fraud, Graph-Based Search, Identity & Access Management, MDM/Data Governance, Network & IT Operations, Real-Time Recommendations and Social Networks.

Neo4j supports the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) technologies into graph-based applications. The combination of Neo4j's graph database with AI/ML capabilities allows organizations to derive deeper insights, make predictions, and discover complex patterns within their connected data.

Graph Algorithms for AI: Neo4j provides a collection of graph algorithms that can be used for various AI tasks. These algorithms are optimized to work with graph-structured data, making them particularly effective for tasks such as community detection, centrality analysis, and pathfinding.

Graph-Based Feature Engineering: Graph databases like Neo4j are well-suited for representing and storing complex relationships in data. This makes them valuable for feature engineering in machine learning, as relationships between entities can be used to create meaningful features for predictive models.

By combining the strengths of graph databases with AI and ML technologies, Neo4j provides a powerful platform for building intelligent applications that can navigate and extract valuable insights from highly interconnected data.

current.employer_name: InterNational Committee for Information Technology Standards (INCITS)
current.employer_linkedin_description: INCITS -- the InterNational Committee for Information Technology Standards -- is the central U.S. forum dedicated to creating technology standards for the next generation of innovation. INCITS members combine their expertise to create the building blocks for globally transformative technologies. From cloud computing to communications, from transportation to health care technologies, INCITS is the place where innovation begins. We are the leading developer of global and U.S. information and communications technology standards.  INCITS members are information technology developers, producers, and users.  Our members come from more than 1,700 companies, universities, consortia, and other groups involved in the production and use of cutting-edge technologies.  The one thing that all of our members have in common is that they have a material stake in how a standard is developed.INCITS is guided by the leadership of our Executive Board.  In addition, we have more than 50 technical committees and study groups that are constantly developing standards for new technologies and updating standards for older products that are evolving through innovation.Domestically, we focus on creating new American National Standards.  Our technical committees grow regularly to match the ever-evolving ICT marketplace.  New products and new approaches come online every day.  INCITS members work with the developers and users before a product goes to market so it is broadly accepted and highly interoperable.In the global arena, we serve as the U.S. Technical Advisory Group (TAG) to the international standards-setting organization called ISO/IEC JTC 1.  INCITS members have direct entry into the international standards arena and participate as voting members of U.S. delegations to global standards meetings and deliberations.
